WALLET FORK CLOSED — SENTINEL IS NEVER GIVEN OUT, ALWAYS OURS
They host the compute, we keep the meter. They resell our credit unit for our service at their own rate. No forked ledger, no per-tenant Sentinel, no wallet in the takeout. Recorded on BEB-6800.

6804 CONSEQUENCE — a moved instance still calls Sentinel over the network
That call path surviving the move is an ACCEPTANCE item, not an assumption. Sentinel unreachable degrades by name, RATE UNAVAILABLE, settlement disabled — never a local fallback ledger.

NO PII ON CREDIT USE — ledger rows carry a KEY, never a person
Key, worker, reason, activity, markup, amount, timestamp, period. No name, email, IP, UA, or prompt text. CRM holds the person, ledger holds the key, they join at read time under auth. Never a copy.

RULING ON RECORD, NOT SPECCED — no PII on credit use
Alex 2026-08-28, deferred by him. Recorded on BEB-3895. Nobody designs against it yet; it pulls against 3898 live usage and the coop attribution requirement, and that tension is his to settle later.

BEB-6805 WORTH A VIDEO — the managers RANK, not just emit
Every landing scored from rows: fires retired, blast radius, age of the fault, claim overturned, visible to a person. Human line written at land time with a real number in it. Today's session is the test set.

BEB-6786 — worker-in-red half deployed both sides (Fable m65838 order done).
- DISPATCHER c002212d: recordExternal accepts `node` and passes it to the attempts INSERT (was node=lane.target=repo). Additive, backward-compatible.
- MASTRA 5f520d87: the deployStep record now sends node=<deployed worker name>. So deploy reds group under the WORKER (abilifi-payload/registry/etc), not alexrollin/abilifi-apps.
- Plus the fail-loud resolver (9adce213 earlier): a monorepo node never substitutes an orky file; owner/repo@subdir -> subdir source (one rule, both callers with the frag-door).
ACCEPTANCE now testable on new failures: a REPEAT_FAILER carries the worker -> self_heal_apply resolves that worker's source -> diff. Watching state for the next deploy fail to confirm it groups by worker; not claiming done until the diff lands. Remaining send-sites (complete stage, other deploy records) get node the same way if their worker is in scope — iterative, named.

ALL-LOOPS CONFORMANCE PASS RUN — ten loops, ONE passes. Table on BEB-3856
The loops that ANSWER are healthy; the loops that ACT are not. Five are not fireable from chat at all. One fix line each on the ticket. Criteria 1 and 3 unevidenced and not claimed.

BEB-6806 LITE SLACK — a zero-deploy account gets Slack, no deploy required
The endpoint is OURS: one multi-tenant abilifi Slack app on our worker, tenant installs by OAuth into their workspace. Same shape as Twilio. A per-tenant Slack app is the wrong design and is refused.

BEB-5766 — Orky's recall corpus decided: RULINGS, not generated specs
Retrieve Alex's rulings, the spec-question log, the search log, the named-practice docs. Never generated specs, never the graph. Blocked by BEB-6779 or it retrieves an incomplete corpus silently.

BEB-6807 FRAG INFO CARD — and it is NOT a new data source
Binds, needs, fencing, deploy level, help, support, request-a-feature on one shortcut. The card RENDERS the graph node that SpecOps already CHECKS — one set of rows, two readers. A separate panel would drift and then lie.

BEB-6807 EXTENDED — admin settings, see it in billing, review access, see notifications
All four are DEEP LINKS into existing surfaces scoped by node id, never panels on the card. Real build item: three of the four surfaces do not accept a frag scope today, so the links would dump you into an unfiltered view.

Updates are emissions on the existing bus filtered by node id — no second feed. What IS new is comments on feed rows: member-attributed, grants-scoped, hide-with-reason. Same store as BEB-6797. Stats deferred by Alex.

PUBLIC ENCODING AT WRITE TIME + VIDEO ON THE ROW, SO USERS CAN SHARE IT
public flag, title and body written with the emission, never backfilled. Recording linked at land time. A row whose video does not resolve is UNPROVEN and unpublishable. Share is one plain URL, no token.

BLOCKER NAMED: none of the sharing works while BEB-6733 truncates uploads at 7500 bytes
Six months, zero video files delivered. Do not build a share button that links to a video that does not play — 6807 reports BUILT/UNWIRED until 6733 lands.

BEB-6808 P0 — TWELVE near-identical specs for ONE deliverable, four in the last twelve hours
All titled TIME RECONSTRUCTION, all against BEB-3582, all asking the same unanswered question. They now outrank real content on a corpus search, which breaks the Orky recall corpus decided yesterday on 5766.

YES — SAME EVENT, DIFFERENT LOOK, SAME KAIRONS. Recorded as binding on BEB-2960
kairon is the player, not the emitter. A variety that adds, drops or reorders a kairon is a defect, not a style choice. Assertable: same task_id in two varieties must produce identical kairon sets.

Kairons are the newscast leaderboard: same furniture in every variety, silky transitions, the scene behind it changes. A look that adds, drops or reorders a kairon is REFUSED at registration.

KAIRON LAYER IS DOM ON TOP, THE JS VIZ IS THE CANVAS UNDERNEATH — recorded on BEB-6811
Text stays text, one shared overlay component, a new look is a canvas and nothing else. Trap named: rrweb does not capture WebGL, so the recorder must composite both layers or you get furniture floating over nothing.

BEB-6815 THE NEWSCAST — and ENDASH IS ALREADY THE VRM PRESENTER, sitting in backlog
BEB-267/249 already spec vrm_size, vrm_view, vrm_expression, layout and mood presets, narrator strip, fixed VRM across transitions. The newscast is Endash driven by a kairon playlist instead of slides. 267 fronted.

CUTS ARE DATA, NOT EDITING — and three blockers named on 6815
Every cut derives from a kairon; same event renders the same cuts twice. Blocked by 6733 truncation, 6772 WebGL capture, and an UNDECIDED audio path — a newscast with no voice is a silent film.
